intro: Explore around 50 changing Japanese sakes at each bar, from seasonal releases to rare finds. Most glasses are ¥600–700, and there is always a friendly face to help you discover your new favorite.
storyTitle:
Come for the sake.
Stay for the conversation.
story: Since opening in Yokohama in 2017, Craft Sake Shoten has brought people together over Japanese sake. Our changing selection is an invitation to explore — from familiar favorites to something you have never tried.
storyMore: New to sake? You are in good company. Ask us about the bottles, discover what you like, and make yourself at home.
contactText: For the latest selection, events & updates, or to get in touch, find us on Instagram.
hoursNote: Check Instagram for special hours before visiting.
hoursPending: For current opening hours, please check the Kawasaki Instagram account before visiting.
beginnerA: You are welcome here. Ask the team to help you discover a style you enjoy.

homePage.title: Japanese Sake Bars in Yokohama & Kawasaki | Craft Sake Shoten
homePage.description: Discover around 50 rotating Japanese sakes at our Yokohama and Kawasaki bars. Seasonal and rare releases, sommelier-selected, and mostly ¥600–700 a glass - enjoyed with good company.

yokohamaPage.title: Yokohama | Craft Sake Shoten
yokohamaPage.description: Visit the original Craft Sake Shoten in Yokohama. Explore Japanese sake, find opening hours and directions, and plan your visit.
yokohamaPage.headline:
A little bar.
A world of sake.
yokohamaPage.body: Our original Yokohama bar is a casual place to discover Japanese sake and meet a friendly crowd. Let curiosity guide your next glass, and let a conversation begin.
yokohamaPage.card: Our original sake bar, founded by Brian in 2017. Come for a changing selection of sake, stay for the friendly crowd and the conversations that follow.
yokohamaPage.access: From Yokohama Station, head toward Minamisaiwai. Find us on the second floor of Shimada Heights; use the map for your route.

kawasakiPage.title: Kawasaki | Craft Sake Shoten
kawasakiPage.description: Discover Craft Sake Shoten’s Kawasaki sake bar at Muza Kawasaki. Find directions, shop updates and visiting information.
kawasakiPage.headline:
Your next glass.
Your kind of place.
kawasakiPage.body: Discover Japanese sake at our Kawasaki bar. Explore a changing selection and take time to find a new favorite, with good conversation along the way.
kawasakiPage.card: A welcoming, modern sake bar just 2 minutes from Kawasaki Station. Pair your next sake discovery with chef designed small plates, settle in, and explore a wide range of sake along with craft shochu, whiskey, and gin with us.
kawasakiPage.access: Find us on the first floor of Muza Kawasaki, near Kawasaki Station’s west exit. Open the map for directions.

storyDetail:
Craft Sake Shoten began in Yokohama in 2017 with a simple idea: make great sake easy to discover and share with good people. Today, our bars in Yokohama and Kawasaki bring that spirit to every glass. Our sommeliers select a wide range of styles, and the lineup changes constantly as new seasonal bottles are released.

Whether you know exactly what you like or are trying sake for the first time, tell us what sounds good. We will help you find a glass you love and make you feel at home.
